notes.title: Adventure Forge: Secret Sauce
notes.content: [p]We're attending Open Sauce as part of Offbrand Games' Secret Sauce! Join us for a live demo of [b]Adventure Forge[/b], our no-code storytelling engine built for branching narratives, RPGs, and interactive adventures. We’ll walk through how the system works, show off powerful features like tags and triggers, and answer any of your burning questions live![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44870356/929b5968360a2ef490b6824983530621f9eda2f4.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Building Games with Endless Adventures
notes.content: Join Eva, Jonathan, and Kevin as they create a visual novel in Adventure Forge. Be part of the conversation and let us know how you want the branching paths to go. The only limit is your imagination!

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Ending
notes.content:
Hey Next Fest Participants,

We hope you have enjoyed the Adventure Forge Next Fest Demo! But like all good things, this too must come to a close. We are sunsetting our Next Fest Demo. If you'd like to keep playing in the Forge, you are welcome to join our Closed Beta program and help us make the tool even better! Reach out to us in Discord and we'll get you a Beta Code.

Please! Record any videos of your games or gameplay you want to keep, as your data won't transfer over. If you publish your game, we might be able to port your data to the Closed Beta, but we can't promise anything, since the dev branches have drifted quite a bit.
Thanks for understanding, and we hope to see you in the Closed Beta! Contact us on Discord if you have questions or would like a Beta Code.

Cheers,
Adventure Forge Team

notes.title: Next Fest Demo Survey
notes.content:
Hey Gamesmiths!

🎮 Did you dive into the Adventure Forge demo during Steam Next Fest? We want to hear from you! 🌟 Your feedback is like gold to us as we continue polishing the Adventure Forge for early access release. 

Please take a moment to fill out our Steam Next Fest Demo Survey and let us know your thoughts! Whether you conquered every challenge or stumbled upon hidden secrets, your experience matters. Help us shape the future of Adventure Forge! Click the link below to share your feedback and be part of the journey.

notes.title: Adventure Forge Demo Hour
notes.content:
Discover Adventure Forge by Endless Adventures, the ultimate toolset for crafting narrative-rich video games with no coding required! Our Next Fest demo lets players create and share their games. Users can also play a selection of games developed by the team using the toolset. 

These games showcase the potential of Adventure Forge to allow community members to become game creators.

Join [b]Jordan Weisman[/b], known for iconic franchises like BattleTech and MechWarrior, as he shares his vision to empower creators with a fast, easy-to-use, no-code authoring system.

Joining him on this journey is:

[b]Ryan Schapals[/b] is a writer and narrative designer with over ten years of experience in the game industry. He's currently the Narrative Director at Cold Symmetry. Experienced in tabletop, mobile, and video games, he's always looking for new ways to tell interactive stories. 

[b]Whitney Beltrán[/b] is an award-winning narrative director and writer for games, best known for HoloVista, Bluebeard's Bride, and Beyond Blue.
